scope: Operational installation and infrastructure acceptance; not a replacement product specification.

criteria.outcome: Every supported shell, IDE, setup, runner and service resolves the same named installation configuration.
acceptance: Resolve a non-default Windows machine.env through PowerShell, CMD and MSBuild; compare paths and provenance.
Separate OS service identity, database identity and credential references; reject missing or conflicting required configuration.

checks.evidence: Execute all three real entry points against one alternate-root fixture.
Real Bash/POSIX imports with alternate declarations, process overrides, dependent paths and literal command syntax. Live host deployment evidence is retained separately.

criteria.outcome: Two worktrees build independently and neither clean operation changes an installed runtime or persistent data.
acceptance: Build different revisions in two worktrees and verify distinct output trees and artifact identities.
Exercise clean with runtime/data sentinels present; preserve operator modifications and declared source roots.

checks.evidence: Two actual managed builds at distinct source revisions, independent output roots, and preservation of the other artifact plus runtime/data sentinels during clean.

criteria.outcome: A release names its complete compatible source, dependency, native, database and prepared-artifact closure.
acceptance: Use immutable dependency revisions from staging through promotion, including the triggering dependency SHA.
Read back matching installed identities; reject stale artifacts, incompatible PG ABI/schema and unsupported CPU baselines.

checks.evidence: A staged and promoted release with exact artifact digests plus rejection cases.

criteria.outcome: Install, repair and upgrade operate on one installation, with recoverable failure boundaries.
acceptance: Install onto a clean declared host, rerun repair without damage, and upgrade from an existing release.
Inject publication/activation failure; recover a coherent release and state, not only its old binaries.
Remove owned services/binaries without deleting persistent knowledge, application data or shared infrastructure.

checks.evidence: Real Windows installation/repair/upgrade/failure-recovery evidence.
Real Linux installation/repair/upgrade/failure-recovery evidence.

criteria.outcome: CI and local maintenance invoke the same operation and target contract without relying on runner leftovers.
acceptance: Run maintenance against the current layout on a replaced runner.
Explicitly resolve tier, machine, role and knowledge target; coordinate shared resources across repositories.
Demonstrate queue/supersession behavior for two differently parameterized operations.

checks.evidence: Clean-runner delivery and maintenance, target resolution and concurrency evidence.
Actual staging workflow execution through the human entry point; does not by itself prove replacement-runner installation.

Start the built Windows application with declared OpenBao-backed runtime identities, separate development application state and selected remote knowledge; execute the same authenticated SQL/native/SPA verifier as deployment.
Actual installed production SQL/native verification and retained configuration/revision receipts through the human entry point.

criteria.outcome: Ingestion is an explicit resumable operation against a selected release and knowledge substrate.
acceptance: Ordinary build/deploy performs no unrequested source admission or database deletion.
Interrupt and resume a named ingest using the recorded input selection and checkpoint; reject incompatible artifacts.

checks.evidence: Deployment no-admission evidence and actual interrupted/resumed ingestion.

criteria.outcome: Linux storage discovery selects the device and mountpoint belonging to the requested path.
acceptance: Nested mounts, escaped spaces, path boundaries and later unrelated rows resolve correctly.

checks.evidence: Detector regression fixture; live mounting validation is recorded separately in the audit.

criteria.outcome: A separate Windows drive is not assumed to be dedicated to PostgreSQL WAL.
acceptance: Default separate-drive storage to shared; recognize explicit dedication and reject invalid/same-drive declarations.

checks.evidence: Windows path/classification fixture with capacity lookup isolated.

criteria.outcome: A plan that declares its own memory overcommit cannot reach database reads/writes through the apply operation.
acceptance: Demonstrate the known desktop overcommit failing before the database boundary on both platforms.
Admit a fitting fixture through the same guard. This does not establish a total workload-memory bound.

checks.evidence: Real apply entry point with database access replaced by a tripwire.
Real apply entry point with database access replaced by a tripwire.

criteria.outcome: Configured budgets reconcile server memory, client pools, service concurrency and actual schedulable CPUs.
acceptance: Compare all resource planners and live PG settings for desktop/server/prod with declared exceptions.
Measure concurrent services and query operators against host/cgroup limits; aggregate all pools by target cluster.

Identify the delivered implementation and artifact hash; compare the same artifact's supported lower-ISA and native AVX-512 paths on eligible hardware, including explicitly scheduled cloud work. Record selected dispatch, compiler/dependency fingerprints and golden-result equality. A skipped ISA test is not a pass; emulation can establish functional evidence but not native performance.

Compare independently compiled golden results under the documented floating-point contract; distinguish compile target, runtime dispatch and numerical reproducibility. Existing Laplace-Native multiversion dispatch must not be replaced by an inferred whole-build ISA contract.

checks.evidence: Resolved plans, live settings and representative concurrent workload measurements.

Read back application-cluster tuning against measured host facts and declared allocations, including service/data-directory identity and no pending restart. This is configuration convergence, not workload saturation or aggregate knowledge-host proof.

criteria.outcome: Operator, deployment and runtime identities have explicit least-privilege access through existing OpenBao and database policies.
acceptance: Enroll the actual workload, refresh credentials without exposing them, and verify intended access plus denied unrelated access.
Demonstrate revocation/recovery; keep OpenBao/Vaultwarden placement and data intact.

checks.evidence: Positive/negative authorization and refresh/revocation tests using the intended workload identity.

Live API OS/database boundaries, two-record read-only workload AppRole, refused migration/shared secrets and denied use after token revocation. Does not establish runner isolation or password-rotation recovery.
Actual desktop runtime logins: permitted data reads, denied administrator impersonation and application DDL, denied cross-database connections. Does not establish OpenBao policy revocation.

criteria.outcome: Each supported client reaches its intended private/public service through verified DNS, routes and TLS.
acceptance: Verify LAN and Tailscale resolution/routing from the actual client hosts; verify Cloudflare API and authenticated MCP behavior.
Demonstrate certificate renewal/distribution ownership rather than only current certificate validity.

checks.evidence: Client-to-service probes plus renewal/distribution evidence.
Live router records and actual server resolver answers agree with Tailscale node identity/address; cloud may remain off.

criteria.outcome: hart-prod performs authenticated useful work against selected compatible hart-server knowledge while hart-cloud remains intentionally off.
acceptance: Record the selected knowledge/artifact identity and verify API and MCP operations through public ingress.
Reject an incompatible target and reverse the selection cleanly; keep the application database separate.
Do not substitute replica freshness for intentional knowledge selection.

checks.evidence: End-to-end operation receipts with cloud-off state and the actual selected target.

criteria.outcome: Recovery of releases, application data, selected knowledge and infrastructure secrets is demonstrated separately.
acceptance: Restore backups to an isolated target and perform application reads with compatible schema/native artifacts.
Record recovery point/time and failure handling; a copied file or readable dump listing is not a restore proof.

checks.evidence: Actual restore/recovery operation receipts without overwriting serving data.

Restore the declared production application backup into a disposable database, execute installed API/key issuance and native operations, verify the restored database actually received the key, and clean up. Does not claim knowledge or infrastructure-secret recovery.

criteria.outcome: Representative operations have measured and regression-checked external round trips and wire bytes.
acceptance: Measure bytes, external round trips, latency, retries and connection establishment for cold/warm operations.
Define an evidence-based regression budget after baseline measurement; distinguish internal SPI work from network calls.

checks.evidence: Representative operation measurements followed by an executable regression budget.

criteria.outcome: Untrusted builds cannot access installed runtime credentials or privileged internal resources.
acceptance: Demonstrate isolation using a harmless denial probe from the untrusted build context.
Keep privileged installation in a separately authorized promotion context.

checks.evidence: Harmless negative-access probes from the actual runner contexts.

criteria.outcome: Hardware eligibility, cloud lifecycle and service placement obey the user's declared machine roles.
acceptance: Keep hart-server's damaged GPU ineligible without running a GPU workload.
Allow optional desktop GPU services through explicit configuration; CPU Laplace installation does not require them.
Cloud work explicitly acquires/releases its resource and does not become an undeclared always-on runtime dependency.
Resolve build host, release tier, serving host and selected knowledge target independently; the on-demand cloud role does not prohibit building production artifacts.

checks.evidence: Role resolution and prohibited-operation rejection tests.

criteria.outcome: Desktop copy-off propagates errors and verifies destination bytes from a fresh manifest.
acceptance: Detect corruption, missing required inputs, partial manifests and copy failures; allow a successful repeated copy.

checks.evidence: Real local copy/readback regression fixture; not database or off-site recovery proof.
